verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev stores run payloads, outputs and logs, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. The pack documents no retention settings, TTLs, or run/data deletion capability. Self-hosting's general "full control over your environment", deleting schedules, and the BAA add-on are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
